Build the exponential-autocorrelation covariance for B-spline coefficients

Source: R/axons.R
dot-bspline_covariance.Rd

Returns the n_basis x n_basis zero-mean Gaussian covariance with entries Sigma[i, j] = variance * exp(-|i - j| / autocorrelation). This is the covariance of the functional random field in the B-spline basis.

Usage

.bspline_covariance(n_basis, variance, autocorrelation)

Arguments

n_basis

Number of B-spline coefficients (basis functions).

variance

Variance sigma^2 (amplitude) shared by all coefficients.

autocorrelation

Positive correlation rate rate > 0 (rate -> 0 gives independent coefficients; larger values give smoother, more coherent streamlines).

Value

An n_basis x n_basis numeric matrix.
